post.summary: Submit a video for AI clipping
post.description:
Submit a video for AI-powered clip generation. Provide either:
- A `video_url` in JSON body, or
- A `video` file via multipart form data.

Each clip costs $1.50 and is deducted from your wallet upfront.
Poll GET /v1/clip/{jobId} for results.

video_url.description: URL of the video to clip. Supports direct video URLs, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and X links.

length.description: Target clip duration in seconds. Omit to let the AI decide.

prompt.description: Custom AI instructions for clip selection (e.g. "focus on product demos" or "find the funniest moments").

camera_mode.description:
Controls how the video is framed for vertical output.
- standard: blurred background with centered video
- facecam: detects facecam overlay and separates gameplay + facecam
- speaker-zoom: zooms into the speaker's face
- center-crop: crops the center of the video
- active-speaker: tracks and zooms into the active speaker (multi-person)

hook_length.description: Hook duration in seconds. The hook is the attention-grabbing opening of each clip. Omit to let the AI decide.

auto_heading.description: Automatically generate a short viral heading overlay for each clip using AI.

heading.description: Heading style customization. Applies to both auto-generated and custom headings.

text.description: Custom heading text. When provided, overrides auto_heading.

style.description: stroke = outlined text, instagram = white text on dark background

color.description: Text color (only applies to stroke style).

position.description: Heading vertical position on the video.

instructions.description: Optional instructions to guide AI heading generation (e.g. "focus on product benefits", "use question-style headings"). Only applies when auto_heading is true and no custom text is provided.

music_url.description: URL to a background music file (mp3, wav, aac). Will be mixed into all clips at 30% volume.

video.description: Video file (mp4, mov, avi, mkv, webm)

length.description: Target clip duration in seconds. Omit to let the AI decide.

prompt.description: Custom AI instructions for clip selection.

camera_mode.description: Controls how the video is framed for vertical output.

hook_length.description: Hook duration in seconds. Omit to let the AI decide.

auto_heading.description: Automatically generate a short viral heading overlay for each clip.

music.description: Background music file (mp3, wav, aac). Will be mixed into all clips at 30% volume.

heading_text.description: Custom heading text. When provided, overrides auto_heading.

heading_style.description: Heading style. stroke = outlined, instagram = white on dark bg.

heading_bg_color.description: Heading background color (only applies to instagram style). Text color auto-adjusts (white bg = black text, black bg = white text).

heading_instructions.description: Optional instructions to guide AI heading generation.

get.description:

heading.description: AI-generated viral heading overlay text (if auto_heading was enabled)

post.summary: Submit a video for face swap
post.description:
Submit a video and face image for AI face swapping. Provide either:
- URLs via JSON (`video_url` + `face_image_url`), or
- Files via multipart form data (`video` + `face_image`), or
- A mix of URL and file.

Cost is $0.20 per second of video (rounded up), deducted upfront.
Maximum video duration is 300 seconds (5 minutes).
Poll GET /v1/face-swap/{jobId} for results.

face_image_url.description: Public URL of the face image

mode.description: face = fast face-only swap (FAL AI), fullbody = full body swap (Kling AI)

video.description: Video file (mp4, mov, webm, avi). Max 500MB.

face_image.description: Face image file (jpg, png, webp). Max 500MB.

get.summary: Get face swap job status

Poll this endpoint to check if your face swap job is ready.
Returns a download URL when status is "completed".

post.summary: Stripe webhook endpoint
post.description:
Handles Stripe webhook events for subscription lifecycle and one-time purchases.
This endpoint receives events from Stripe and processes them accordingly.

Supported events:
- checkout.session.completed (for one-time addon purchases)
- customer.subscription.created
- customer.subscription.updated
- customer.subscription.deleted
- invoice.payment_succeeded
- invoice.payment_failed

get.summary: Get available Stripe prices
get.description:
Returns the configured Stripe price IDs for all subscription plans and addons.

**Subscription Plans** (monthly recurring):
- STUDIO: 500 clips/month
- SCALE: 1000 clips/month

**Addon Packs** (one-time purchase, adds to monthly limit):
- STUDIO_ADDON: +50 clips
- SCALE_ADDON: +100 clips

get.summary: Get live analytics plan prices from Stripe
get.description:
Fetches current pricing for analytics subscription tiers directly from the Stripe API.
Returns the unit amount in cents, currency, and billing interval for each analytics plan.

500.description: Failed to fetch prices from Stripe

post.summary: Create a Stripe checkout session
post.description:
Creates a new Stripe checkout session for subscription or one-time addon purchase.
Returns a URL to redirect the user to Stripe's hosted checkout page.

**Subscription plans** (STUDIO, SCALE): Creates a recurring subscription.
**Addon purchases** (STUDIO_ADDON, SCALE_ADDON): Creates a one-time payment
that adds clips to the team's monthly limit. Can be purchased multiple times.

teamId.description: The team ID to associate the purchase with

priceId.description:
Stripe price ID for the selected plan or addon.
- STUDIO/SCALE: Creates a subscription
- STUDIO_ADDON (+50 clips): One-time purchase
- SCALE_ADDON (+100 clips): One-time purchase

successUrl.description: URL to redirect after successful payment

cancelUrl.description: URL to redirect if user cancels

url.description: Stripe checkout URL to redirect the user to

400.description: Invalid request - missing teamId, priceId, or invalid price
